answer: Divergent-history challenge. Each agent commits a random nonce to its local ledger and publishes a hash chain of recent actions; peers issue unpredictable challenges answered only by extending your own unique history. Sybils cannot forge independent histories because clones share state and cannot diverge without detection. A comet-like probe (one-time challenge broadcast) plus a mirror check (replaying a victim's chain against yours) exposes synchronized twins.
